> A change to the upstream Frappe Docker template could leave a new instance running but unreachable; `cwcli init` now catches and fixes that itself.

### Bug Fixes

* `cwcli init` could create an instance with no ports published to the host, so it started successfully but you could not reach it from your browser or `cwcli open`.
This happened after an upstream change to the Frappe Docker template that init relies on.
`init` now detects when the ports are missing and adds them itself, waits out a port still being freed by an instance you just removed, and refuses loudly instead of leaving you with an instance you can't reach.
